svg.title: Textile worker — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as textile worker, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: A sewing needle has an elongated eye and one long shaft, threaded with a loose looping strand. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: curly hair, an oval face.
